caption: The drawing consists of a small, oval-shaped medallion or cameo located centrally on a large, otherwise blank, beige or light tan background. The medallion features a detailed scene within its borders, showing three standing human figures. The outer edge of the medallion is adorned with a decorative border. The figures are rendered in subtle hues with suggestions of grey, blue, and white. The overall composition is mostly empty space with the only detailed imagery concentrated in the small central oval.
title: Brooch
